definitions.gloss: rare and curious; strange; exotic; outlandish
definitions.explanation: Something that is both rare and unusual, often attracting curiosity. Can describe objects, animals, plants, or behaviors that are strikingly different from the norm.

examples.japanese: {珍奇|ちんき}な⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: I collect rare and unusual plants.

examples.japanese: {珍奇|ちんき}な⟦{風習|ふうしゅう}→風習：05826_fuushuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised by the exotic customs.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{珍奇|ちんき}な⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{標本|ひょうほん}→標本：13174_hyouhon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That museum displays specimens of rare and curious animals from around the world.

notes:
{珍奇|ちんき} combines {珍|ちん} (rare/unusual) and {奇|き} (strange/curious), creating a word that emphasizes both rarity and strangeness.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{珍|めずら}しい→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧ — rare, unusual (common, neutral word)
- {珍奇|ちんき} — rare and curious (more literary; emphasizes oddness)
- ⟦{奇妙|きみょう}→奇妙：01630_kimyou⟧ — strange, peculiar (emphasizes oddness without rarity)

{珍奇|ちんき} is somewhat literary and more commonly found in written descriptions than in casual conversation.
